create_statemanager: create a StateManager instance to track stateful components of a solver
register_state_source: register a StateDictSource with the StateManager using a name and optional write_only flag
build_state_dict: build a combined state dictionary from all registered sources via StateManager state_dict
load_state_dict: load state into all registered sources from a state dictionary using StateManager load_state_dict
wrap_attribute: wrap an object attribute as a StateDictSource using AttributeWrapper for state tracking
